cluster_name.description: Teleport cluster name (opt.). Used with a multi-cluster Teleport configuration (trust between root and leaf clusters).

deny.description: Deny-list of (host, user) pairs; the provider is allow-all by default (dev/test). Each entry — `{host?, user?}`; an empty field = wildcard on that dimension (symmetric with soul-ssh-static / soul-ssh-vault).

identity_file.description: Path to the Teleport identity-file (usually issued by `tctl auth sign` or `tbot`). Alternative — tbot_socket. One of the two sources is required.

proxy_addr.description: Teleport proxy endpoint (`host:port`, usually :3023 for SSH proxy). Goes into SignReply.proxy_jump for later use by keeper.push (dispatcher proxy_jump support — S3, see docs/keeper/push.md).

roles.description: List of Teleport roles under which certificates for the end user are requested. Empty list = default roles assigned to the identity-file/tbot-bot.

tbot_socket.description: Path to the `tbot` daemon's Unix socket, if used (renewable credentials without an identity-file on disk). Mutually exclusive with identity_file (oneOf).

valid_principals.description: Allowlist of principals (Linux users) that the plugin allows to place in the signed cert. Empty list = accept any `req.user` (if the Teleport role allows it). Hard restriction for production.
